MachineAssignment.description: Why a runtime belongs to its machine.

oneOf.description: The machine pins the runtime ID.
The machine stands for the machine ID the runtime reports.

The runtime is not connected, and the machine stands for the
machine ID it reported when the daemon last saw it (client
protocol 1.10.0).

MachineInfo.description: One machine: a computer that runtimes run on.

connected.description: The connected runtimes assigned to the machine, by runtime ID.

ids.description:
The opaque machine IDs the machine stands for: a runtime that
reports one of them belongs to it.

memories.description: The memory files in the machine's memory folder.

pinned.description: Runtime IDs pinned to the machine, whatever they report.

platform.description: The operating system its connected runtimes report, when they agree.

remembered.description:
The runtimes not connected now that the daemon remembers on the
machine, by runtime ID (client protocol 1.10.0). Empty from an older
daemon.

MachineRuntime.description: A connected runtime assigned to a machine.

platform.description: The operating system the runtime reports.

RememberedRuntime.description:
A runtime the daemon remembers on a machine while it is not connected
(client protocol 1.10.0): one that connected before, whose machine ID,
platform, and home the registry recorded.

assigned_by.description: `pinned` when the machine pins the runtime ID, else `last_seen`.

home.description: The home directory the runtime reported when it last connected.

last_seen.description: When the daemon last saw the runtime connect or disconnect.

platform.description: The operating system the runtime reported when it last connected.

description:
Every machine of the daemon's machine registry, in name order. Each
`machines.*` change answers with the machines afterwards.
